response.overview: A lazy, disheveled man stumbles into bed after setting his alarm, expecting another dull morning. But when the ringing wakes him at dawn, the alarm clock is nowhere to be found. Confused and groggy, he begins a desperate search, only to realize that nothing in his apartment is quite as he remembers. What starts as a simple hunt for a misplaced object spirals into a nightmarish journey, where reality twists, deception lurks at every turn, and the boundaries between sanity and madness blur.
response.title: La sveglia.
